packages.subject: Power Link
packages.canon_status: CANDIDATE (unchanged; delegated design selection is not owner acceptance)

stage_receipts.receipt: receipt.json in that root (file inventory with SHA-256, source identity, environment, commands)
stage_receipts.what_exists: Deterministic editable source geometry (Python builder + mesh kit), glTF/OBJ exports for LOD0/LOD1 of the main mesh and two part meshes, sockets and simple collision boxes, review renders of front/side/rear/left/top and Unreal-camera tactical views for connected, disconnected, maintenance, LOD1 and crowd states, structural tests.
stage_receipts.what_does_not_exist: Textures, materials, Unreal import, gameplay-proxy integration, any gate pass, owner acceptance.

stage_receipts.what_exists: Headless Interchange import of all three meshes with LOD1, sockets, collision, UV channels, lightmap index, Nanite-off, replace-reimport equality, all checks passing; socket-encoding probes.
stage_receipts.what_does_not_exist: In-engine rendered inspection, materials, integration into the shared game, gate passes, owner acceptance.

stage_receipts.result: Three lenses, two skeptics per finding; upheld findings dispositioned in revision v3 (see README 6.2); the mast-proportion finding was refuted because the blockout follows the contract's construction reference; slenderness versus the painted candidate recorded as an owner question.

Five 1024^2 maps (BaseColor, Normal DirectX green-down, MRE, StateMask, AtlasDebug) baked from the v3 atlas by ebs_texbake.py, 722/722 charts painted, deterministic, independently verified against the bake manifest (no blocking or major defects; eight minor defects recorded for the ART_ALPHA bake). Not yet: Material instances, in-engine textured capture, 2048^2 stack, gate reviews, owner acceptance.

Concept rework to the candidate proportions: octagonal tower 780 cm at W 200 (3.9 W, measured on the candidate pixels), single load collar at 0.72 H, four near-square numbered panels, two-step plinth with outboard couplings, Ø 0.16 W segmented conduit stubs; re-baked 1024^2 maps on the new atlas; 42 tests; comparison sheets 01-09 against concepts A/B and the candidate; two independent verification lenses (fidelity, rules) and a fix pass; headless import run 10: 3 meshes, all checks pass. Not yet: Hanging-conduit part (OWNER-QUESTION OQ-2), owner ruling on the pixel-measured proportion amendment (OQ-1), textures rebake at 2048^2, in-engine capture, gates, owner acceptance.

packages.next: Hanging-conduit part (OWNER-QUESTION OQ-2), owner ruling on the pixel-measured proportion amendment (OQ-1), textures rebake at 2048^2, in-engine capture, gates, owner acceptance.
